title: Finite evidence accompanying Bush and Turing on the Purpose of AI
scope: Illustrative finite reservation models. No proof about Bush, Turing, intelligence, usefulness, production systems, authentication, or human intent.

entries.description: After release, reserve is rejected as a duplicate.
entries.title: Replay-safe one-use reservation

data.execution: JavaScript Worker finite-model interpreter; Python reference fixtures are definitions and provenance, not a live Python runtime.

ideas: An accepted request identity must not acquire the resource twice.
assumptions: The supplied authorized Boolean is an observation, not authenticated truth.
One modeled process lifetime. No persistent identity or external delivery claim.
questions: After release, should the same identity be accepted again, rejected, or is neither interpretation right?
